question: Who among the following is an Indian professional tennis player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ankita Raina.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ankita Ravinderkrishan Raina (born 11 January 1993) is an Indian professional tennis player.** 
 
• Raina has won one title on the **WTA Tour and one at WTA 125 tournaments (both in doubles).**
 
• Along with **11 singles** and **20 doubles titles on the ITF Circuit.**
 
• Raina has also won **gold medals** in the** women's singles **and** mixed doubles events at the 2016 South Asian Games.**
 
• And won a bronze medal in singles at the 2018 Asian Games.
 
• Raina is** **one of only two women representing India who has won a WTA-level title.​

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Bala Devi**

 
 
• ​Bala Devi is an** Indian women's footballer.**
 
• She plays as a** **forward for Scottish Women's Premier League club Rangers and India women's national football team.
 
 
 
• **Shanti Mallick​**
 
 
• Shanti Mallick is the** ****first female footballer in India **to have been awarded the **Arjuna award in 1983.**
 
 
 
• **​Aditi Chauhan**
 
 
• ​Aditi Chauhan is an Indian women's** professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Indian national team.**
